🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-01 23:00 → 2026-11-02 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **The profile spec survived a colder review** — a fresh run of the checks confirmed draft 4 closes the first finding. [PR #1 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/wyriwe-signing/pull/1#pullrequestreview-5739916061)

> **A gap in self-grading tests drew a targeted fix** — the harness would require every admitted case to be exercised instead of passing empty. [PR #78](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/78)

> **A cross-standard bridge drew support** — a co-sign backed reading ERC-8434's resolver as reconstructing an anchor's authority intervals in the ERC-8004 thread. [ERC-8004 discussion](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/432)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### wyriwe-signing
_The trust-profile direction moved from drafting into a harsher review cycle, with its open design choices becoming explicit._

- Baby Blue Viper **Drafted** the third revision of the signing profile with authenticated trust roots and execution details, giving reviewers a concrete artifact to test instead of an outline to interpret — [PR #1](https://github.com/trustless-ai/wyriwe-signing/pull/1)
- An open issue **Framed** AnchorRegistry as the registry option, noting it is already deployed and permissionless at 23,903 gas, which lets the group settle a design question with measured facts rather than intuition — [issue #2](https://github.com/trustless-ai/wyriwe-signing/issues/2)

### recompute-kit
_The kit's self-checks got harder to satisfy, which is exactly the point._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Proposed** tooling rules that any test under tools/ must be called and every call must point at a real test, keeping the harness from drifting away from what it claims to cover — [PR #84](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/84)
- A cold pass **Revisited** the two live-only exclusions and proposed fresh dates while main CI had been red since 24 October, so the suite's blind spots stay documented rather than forgotten — [PR #87](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/87)
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Checked** both pull requests, backed #87 on structure while leaving the exclusion sign-off to its owner, and flagged a possible enforcement gap in #81, sharpening the next round of fixes — [tg:tawg:5996]

### zkIE
_The proof direction got a broad soundness sweep._

- Jimmy Shi **Addressed** soundness findings S1 through S6, spanning Fiat–Shamir challenge derivation, LogUp binding, and reverse verification, hardening the argument that proofs cannot be forged or quietly replayed — [PR #46](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/46)

### onboarding
_The receipts and attestations thread gained a new teammate._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Introduced** Ben as a senior growth manager and connected his arrival to the receipts and attestations work, giving that thread a teammate who can translate it for outside audiences — [tg:tawg:5985]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Settle the registry question for the signing profile now that AnchorRegistry is on the table with deployment and gas figures.
- Carry the receipts and attestations story into growth conversations so the new teammate's context turns into reach.
- Watch whether the soundness sweep suggests a reusable review checklist for future circuit work.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Close the remaining sign-off on the two live-only exclusions with their owner.
- Examine the enforcement gap flagged in #81 before the next kit pass.
- Fold the resolved profile findings into a short guide for the next drafting round.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A draft went out, a cold re-run found a gap, and the next revision closed it.
>
> Keep that relay rhythm going; every cold re-run is just the team warming up. 🔁
